details: Expanded national starter reference catalogue for CropSentinel.
182 distinct crop entries, including additional fruits, vegetables, leafy greens, root/tuber crops and mushrooms.
This is not literally every crop grown in India and not a validated diagnosis dataset. Values vary by cultivar, state, season, growth stage, soil type and management.
Indicative screening ranges, not universal stress thresholds. Some crops have special requirements such as winter chilling or stage-specific limits.
Broad environmental suitability ranges, not irrigation prescriptions. Use effective rainfall, soil water balance and crop duration for operational recommendations.
A single ideal relative-humidity range is not appropriate for all crops/stages; leaf wetness and disease risk may matter more.
Do not use one percentage for every crop. Calibrate sensor readings and set thresholds by crop, soil texture and growth stage.
Mushrooms are not field crops in the same sense; soil pH and annual rainfall may not apply. Use substrate and controlled-environment parameters.
Store crop profile separately from observation records. Record crop, variety, location, sowing date, growth stage, sensor readings, source, timestamp and alert reason.
